IncidentBot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PAGE fired for inference-gateway (us-east1). Alert: http_5xx_rate > 5% over 5m. Linked PD incident: https://pd.example.com/incidents/P12345
PagerDutyBot: Pager triggered -> on-call: @Maya (primary-sre). Escalation policy: standard-inference. Paging via SMS/call.
Maya: acked via PD. I'll take initial triage.
Maya: seeing spike in 502/503s from inference-gateway-prod-us-east1 -> 5xx rate 7.3% across edge nodes.
Felix: looking at logs, KV cache errors + upstream 502s to runtime-v2-canary. snippet: ```[2026-03-06T03:12:11Z] 502 POST /v1/generate svc=runtime-v2-canary conn=closed kvcache=miss error="upstream reset"```
Tilly: runbook? link to incident runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx
Maya: following the runbook: check canary, circuit-tracing, and recent deploys. No recent infra deploys in last 30m, but canary model rollout finished ~10m ago.
Jason: I can push a quick rollback of the canary model variant if needed. Any sign it's saturated GPUs?
Felix: yes, GPU mem contended on canary nodes, OOM-ish signals and upstream resets. Metric: runtime_v2_canary_gpu_util > 98% for 6m.
Maya: ok plan: 1) scale up dedicated pool by +2 nodes 2) pause canary routing -> shift traffic to runtime-v2-stable 3) enable regional fallback to us-west1. I'll do (2) now.
Maya: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/route/update -d '{"service":"inference-gateway","route_policy":"pause-canary"}'` -- done.
PagerDutyBot: PD note: Maya acknowledged, action: pause-canary triggered.
Tara: Customer Impact check: CS dashboard shows 12 open tickets related to timeouts in last 15m, 3 flagged as high-priority (enterprise customers). Notifying CS reps.
CustomerSuccessBot: Notifying account owners for impacted tenants: acct-omega, acct-sparrow. Slack DM sent.
Jason: rolling back canary version -> running `deploy rollback runtime-v2-canary` in prod. Will monitor.
Felix: also bumping autoscale min by 2 for eu/us pools: `k8s scale --replicas=+2 nodepool-inference`. Doing now.
Maya: adding temporary rate-limiter to protect backend: `limit-rps --service inference-gateway --global 5000` to throttle noisy clients.
Tilly: switching routing confirmed. Traffic now at 98% -> stable. 5xx rate dropping to 2.1% (3m window).
Maya: PD: update -> mitigation actions executed (pause-canary, rollback, scale up). Observed 5xx rate fall from 7.3% -> 1.9% in 8m.
Jason: continuing to watch. I'll be on the bridge for the next 30m, if Maya needs handoff in shift change pls call out.
Maya: handing off in 12m to Jason for watch. Leaving notes: watch kvcache_misses, runtime_v2_errors, gpu_util.
Felix: logs show one noisy tenant making repeated heavy short requests causing prefix cache churn. We should throttle that tenant or apply per-tenant burst limits.
Tara: CS already flagged tenant acct-omega, contacting them to reduce burstiness.
PagerDutyBot: Escalation suppressed (ack present). No further PD escalations.
Tilly: adding postmortem placeholders: severity=SEV3, impact: ~12 customers, degraded latencies & 5xx. Start doc: https://incidents.redwood/postmortems/P12345
Maya: will follow up with RCA + config change to enforce per-tenant burst caps and a model-routing healthcheck to avoid canary overloads.
CustomerSuccessBot: will email affected customers with status update in 30m.
Jason: observed residual 5xx ~0.7% over last 5m, baseline ~0.2%. I'll keep monitoring for 1h then close PD if stable.
Maya: thanks team. Adding reactions :thumbsup: :coffee:
IncidentBot: This thread will be auto-archived after incident close.
